name: How long does a typical bathroom remodel take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom remodel take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom remodel can vary significantly based on its scope. A cosmetic update, involving paint and fixture replacements, might take 1-2 weeks. A complete gut and remodel, including layout changes, new plumbing, and electrical work, typically ranges from 3 to 6 weeks. Factors like material availability, inspection schedules, and unexpected discoveries can influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront to manage expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical bathroom remodel can take from 1-2 weeks for cosmetic changes to 3-6 weeks for a full renovation, depending on scope and other factors.
